samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection Circuit for a Single-Bit Input Signal</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the detection process.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a successful detection.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>INITIAL = 3'b000;</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE1 = 3'b001;</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE2 = 3'b010;</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE3 = 3'b011;</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE4 = 3'b100;</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE5 = 3'b101;</parameter>
        <parameter>MATCH_STATE = 3'b110;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register holding the current state.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register holding the next state.</reg>
        <always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST)>
            if (RST)
                current_state <= INITIAL;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        </always>
        
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                INITIAL: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1)
                        next_state = STATE1;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                STATE1: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0)
                        next_state = STATE2;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                STATE2: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0)
                        next_state = STATE3;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                STATE3: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1)
                        next_state = STATE4;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                STATE4: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1)
                        next_state = MATCH_STATE;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                MATCH_STATE: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1)
                        next_state = STATE1;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                
                default: next_state = INITIAL;
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        <assign MATCH = ((current_state == MATCH_STATE && IN == 1'b1));
    </implementation>
</module>
